metrics.name: quantity_sold
metrics.description: Net historical line quantity after preaggregated partial cancellation, excluding fully cancelled orders. Analytical grain is determined by the requested dimension: variant uses line_item.variant_id; product uses product_variant.product_id. Display labels never define aggregation grain.

metrics.name: unique_variants
metrics.description: Count distinct non-null line_item.variant_id among qualifying orders in the requested period.
